The '''Museum of Corellian History''' was a museum in the [[Axial Park]] district of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Thanaton]] made his headquarters there, and his rival [[Darth Nox|Lord Kallig]] attacked the museum.
